programmes.d: In this anime classic, a powerful wind has left all memories erased. Two years later, a young man travels on a journey to find the truth about the apocalyptic wind.

Utena Tenjou, a mysterious transfer student, gets drawn into duels at the Ohtori Academy to win the hand of the Rose Bride and the power to bring on a revolution in this retelling of the surrealist shoujo classic.

Long ago, the land was in a state of chaos as the feudal lords waged territorial wars. In the midst of the bloodshed, a ferocious warrior, known as the Demon King, appeared and conquered all. It is now 400 years later.
Meet the four members of RWBY as they take on the evils in Remnant and learn to work together.
Second semester starts for Team RWBY! Between classes and homework, the world still needs saving!
At the Vytal Festival Tournament, it's Huntsmen against Huntresses and the new Remnant fighters.
With the Fall of Beacon behind them each member of RWBY must now embark on their own unique journey.
The members of RWBY each have their own journey, but they share a single destination: Haven Academy.
RWBY is reunited and now they must begin the perilous job of escorting the Relic of Knowledge to Atlas.
